item.lead_in: A pathogenic variant in which type of protein most likely underlies this patient's disease?
item.tested_construct: Pathogenic variants in desmosomal proteins such as plakophilin-2 impair mechanical coupling between cardiomyocytes. Progressive myocyte injury and fibrofatty replacement, especially in the right ventricle, create an arrhythmogenic substrate that can produce ventricular tachycardia with left bundle branch block morphology and epsilon waves.

item.lead_in: The affected protein normally performs which cellular function?
item.tested_construct: Desmoplakin is a desmosomal structural protein that anchors intermediate filaments to the desmosomal plaque, enabling mechanical coupling between cardiomyocytes. DSP variants can cause a left-dominant arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy with myocardial fibrosis, ventricular arrhythmias, and episodic myocardial injury.
In third-degree AV block, atrial impulses fail to conduct to the ventricles, so atria and ventricles beat independently and a slow escape rhythm maintains ventricular activity.

item.lead_in: Which of the following best describes the normal function of the affected gene product?
item.tested_construct: TBX5 encodes a T-box transcription factor required for coordinated development of the upper limbs and heart. Haploinsufficiency disrupts radial-ray development and cardiac septation/conduction, producing the characteristic heart-hand phenotype.

item.lead_in: Which hepatocyte transport process is most directly impaired?
item.tested_construct: ABCB11 encodes the bile salt export pump (BSEP), an ATP-binding cassette transporter on the canalicular membrane of hepatocytes that mediates biliary bile-acid export. BSEP deficiency causes PFIC2 with cholestasis and typically low or normal GGT.

item.lead_in: Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
item.tested_construct: Loss of the intestinal SLC26A3 chloride-bicarbonate exchanger impairs chloride absorption and bicarbonate secretion in ileum/colon, causing chloride-rich watery diarrhea, extracellular-volume depletion, hypochloremia, hypokalemia, and metabolic alkalosis.
